```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"More than 600,000 inmates will be released from prison this year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Without intervention, approximately two-thirds of released inmates will likely be rearrested within three years of their release.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President has proposed a four-year, $300 million initiative to reduce recidivism and help released inmates contribute to their communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The initiative will harness the resources and experience of faith-based and community organizations in providing job training and placement services to 50,000 non-violent adult ex-offenders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The initiative will provide transitional housing for up to 30,000 ex-offenders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The initiative will provide voluntary mentoring support for ex-offenders desiring it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Drug abuse and addiction ruin lives.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Every adult has a responsibility to teach children about the dangers of drugs – in terms of both physical harm and potential death, as well as lost opportunities for success.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"After witnessing eight years of Presidential inaction on the war against drugs during the prior Administration, we applaud President Bush for his steady commitment to reducing drug use among teens.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Administration recently exceeded its two-year goal of reducing drug use among young people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"There was an 11 percent drop in the use of illicit drugs by teenagers between 2001 and 2003.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The use of some drugs— such as LSD— has dropped to record-low levels among teens.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"For other drugs, we are seeing the lowest levels of use in almost a decade among teens.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
